## Modules

- [Ecto.Adapters.QuackDB](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/Ecto.Adapters.QuackDB.md): Minimal Ecto SQL adapter for QuackDB.
- [Ecto.Adapters.QuackDB.Connection](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/Ecto.Adapters.QuackDB.Connection.md): Ecto SQL connection callbacks backed by the QuackDB DBConnection driver.
- [Ecto.Adapters.QuackDB.Query](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/Ecto.Adapters.QuackDB.Query.md): Read-oriented Ecto query SQL generation for QuackDB.
- [QuackDB](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.md): Remote DuckDB Quack protocol client.
- [QuackDB.Analytics](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Analytics.md): Direct SQL helpers for DuckDB analytical statements.

- [QuackDB.Binary](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Binary.md): Downloads and locates a DuckDB executable for local `QuackDB.Server` usage.
- [QuackDB.Columns](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Columns.md): Column-oriented query result.
- [QuackDB.Cursor](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Cursor.md): Cursor metadata used by `DBConnection` streaming.
- [QuackDB.DDL](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.DDL.md): Small DuckDB DDL SQL builders.
- [QuackDB.DML](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.DML.md): Small DuckDB DML SQL builders.
- [QuackDB.Ecto](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Ecto.md): Convenience imports for Ecto-based QuackDB query modules.
- [QuackDB.Ecto.Analytics](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Ecto.Analytics.md): DuckDB analytical expression helpers for Ecto queries.
- [QuackDB.Ecto.Conditionals](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Ecto.Conditionals.md): Conditional expression helpers for Ecto analytical queries.
- [QuackDB.Ecto.FTS](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Ecto.FTS.md): DuckDB full-text search expression helpers for Ecto queries.
- [QuackDB.Ecto.List](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Ecto.List.md): DuckDB LIST/ARRAY expression helpers for Ecto queries.
- [QuackDB.Ecto.Map](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Ecto.Map.md): DuckDB MAP expression helpers for Ecto queries.
- [QuackDB.Ecto.Regex](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Ecto.Regex.md): DuckDB regular-expression helpers for Ecto queries.
- [QuackDB.Ecto.Series](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Ecto.Series.md): Ecto source helpers for DuckDB `generate_series` table functions.
- [QuackDB.Ecto.Spatial](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Ecto.Spatial.md): DuckDB spatial expression helpers for Ecto queries.
- [QuackDB.Ecto.Star](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Ecto.Star.md): DuckDB star and `COLUMNS(...)` expression macros for Ecto SQL generation.
- [QuackDB.Ecto.Struct](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Ecto.Struct.md): DuckDB STRUCT expression helpers for Ecto queries.
- [QuackDB.Ecto.Text](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Ecto.Text.md): DuckDB text-expression helpers for Ecto queries.
- [QuackDB.Ecto.WindowFrames](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Ecto.WindowFrames.md): DuckDB window-frame helpers for Ecto queries.
- [QuackDB.Explorer](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Explorer.md): Optional Explorer integration for QuackDB results.
- [QuackDB.Extension](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Extension.md): SQL builders for DuckDB extension management.
- [QuackDB.FTS](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.FTS.md): SQL helpers for DuckDB's full-text search extension.
- [QuackDB.Geometry](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Geometry.md): Helpers for DuckDB spatial `GEOMETRY` values.
- [QuackDB.Interval](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Interval.md): DuckDB interval value preserving month, day, and microsecond components.
- [QuackDB.List](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.List.md): SQL expression helpers for DuckDB LIST/ARRAY values.
- [QuackDB.Map](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Map.md): SQL expression helpers for DuckDB MAP values.
- [QuackDB.Meta](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Meta.md): DuckDB catalog and metadata helpers.
- [QuackDB.Meta.Column](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Meta.Column.md): A row from DuckDB's `pragma_table_info` table function.
- [QuackDB.Meta.Database](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Meta.Database.md): A row from DuckDB's `PRAGMA database_list`.
- [QuackDB.Meta.Table](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Meta.Table.md): A row from DuckDB's table listing pragmas.
- [QuackDB.NanosecondTime](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.NanosecondTime.md): DuckDB `TIME_NS` value stored as nanoseconds since midnight.
- [QuackDB.NanosecondTimestamp](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.NanosecondTimestamp.md): DuckDB `TIMESTAMP_NS` value stored as nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.
- [QuackDB.Profile](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Profile.md): DuckDB query profiling helpers.
- [QuackDB.Profile.Operator](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Profile.Operator.md): A DuckDB profiling operator node.
- [QuackDB.Query](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Query.md): Query metadata used by the DBConnection driver.

- [QuackDB.Result](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Result.md): Normalized query result.
- [QuackDB.SQL](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.SQL.md): Client-side SQL parameter formatting for DuckDB Quack queries.
- [QuackDB.SQL.Fragment](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.SQL.Fragment.md): Reusable SQL fragments shared by QuackDB statement builders.
- [QuackDB.Secret](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Secret.md): SQL builders for DuckDB secrets.
- [QuackDB.Sequence](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Sequence.md): Helpers for DuckDB sequences.
- [QuackDB.Server](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Server.md): Supervises a local DuckDB Quack server process with MuonTrap.
- [QuackDB.Source](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Source.md): Safe SQL fragment builders for DuckDB table-producing data sources.
- [QuackDB.Spatial](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Spatial.md): SQL helpers for DuckDB's spatial extension.
- [QuackDB.Storage](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Storage.md): DuckDB storage observability helpers.
- [QuackDB.Storage.CompressionSummary](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Storage.CompressionSummary.md): Compression summary grouped by table column.
- [QuackDB.Storage.DatabaseSize](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Storage.DatabaseSize.md): A row from DuckDB's `pragma_database_size` table function.
- [QuackDB.Storage.Segment](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Storage.Segment.md): A row from DuckDB's `pragma_storage_info` table function.
- [QuackDB.Stream](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Stream.md): Lazy stream returned by `QuackDB.stream/4`.

- [QuackDB.Struct](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Struct.md): SQL expression helpers for DuckDB STRUCT values.
- [QuackDB.TimeWithTimeZone](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.TimeWithTimeZone.md): DuckDB `TIME WITH TIME ZONE` value.
- [QuackDB.Type](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Type.md): DuckDB SQL type rendering shared by DDL and source helpers.

- Exceptions
  - [QuackDB.Error](https://quackdb.hexdocs.pm/QuackDB.Error.md): Structured error returned by the QuackDB client.
